notes.title: Winter Wonderland Update + New Game Mode
notes.notes:
Evoke is getting festive!

We've been working really hard to get you an update before the end of 2018!

As promised we have given you a new game mode to try out! Infinite mode will force you to use all of your spells to survive and score as many points as possible! Don't forget to tweet us your high scores! @polyflame

While here in Australia we are in the sweltering heat of summer! We can virtually cool off in a snow covered Greyhelm Forest! Check it out yourself before all the snow melts!


Happy Holidays!  See you all in 2019 <3

- Polyflame
